The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kidriff 5]] had a '''primary moon'''. During a [[Raid on Kidriff 5|battle]] fought there in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Zsinj's Empire]], most of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue]] and [[Wraith Squadron]]s orbited the moon while waiting to escort the ''[[Millennium Falsehood]]'' out of the system.
